Read NTFV (Traffic Volume) File

Source: R/read_ntfv.R
read_ntfv.Rd

This function parses SAAM/Gasel .ntfv files. These files define "Traffic Volumes" (TVs), which are groupings of flights (flows) passing through specific points or airspaces.

The file structure is hierarchical:

  • Extension: ntfv

  • Separator: Semicolon (;)

The file consists of:

  1. First Line: Metadata starting with #.

  2. Traffic Volume Headers (T): Define the volume properties. The number of fields varies by location type.

  3. Flow Element Lines (F): Define the specific flows included/excluded in that volume.

Header Types:

  • Type 1 (AD/AZ): 8 Fields. (No FL or Skip info).

  • Type 2 (AS/SP/DBP): 10 Fields. Includes Min/Max FL or Skip In/Out times.

Common Fields (T):

  • ID, Name, Category (MO/_), Ref Location Name, Ref Location Type (AD, AZ, AS, SP, DBP), Role (D, A, G), Nb Elements.

Variable Fields (T):

  • For AS/SP/DBP: Field 8 (Min FL / Skip In), Field 9 (Max FL / Skip Out).

Flow Lines (F):

  • Field 2: Flow Element ID

  • Field 3: Flow Type (IN, IE, EX, EM)

Usage

read_ntfv(ntfv_file)

Arguments

ntfv_file

Path to the .ntfv file.

Value

A data.table with the following columns:

  • tv_id: Traffic Volume ID.

  • tv_name: Traffic Volume Name/Description.

  • tv_category: Category (e.g., MO).

  • ref_loc_name: Reference Location Name.

  • ref_loc_type: Reference Location Type (AD, AZ, AS, SP, DBP).

  • ref_loc_role: Reference Role (D, A, G).

  • min_fl_or_skip_in: Min Flight Level or Skip In time (Numeric).

  • max_fl_or_skip_out: Max Flight Level or Skip Out time (Numeric).

  • flow_id: The ID of the flow element (Child).

  • flow_type: The type of the flow element (IN, EX, etc.).

Details

Reads a .ntfv file defining traffic volumes and their flow elements.
